title: paracyclea insularis

As a medicinal plant, it is valued for its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Paracyclea insularis, such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including pain relief, wound healing, and immune system modulation.
